problem: University students struggle to find compatible peers for collaborative studying, leading to isolated studying and lower academic engagement.
target_user: University students looking for study partners within their enrolled courses.
goals: Enable students to create profiles with their courses, schedules, and study styles
Provide an automated matching algorithm to connect compatible students
Include a messaging interface for matched students to coordinate study sessions
non_goals: Video calling or built-in virtual classroom features
Integration with official university learning management systems (LMS)
Monetization or payment processing for tutoring services
requirements: User authentication restricted to university email domains
Course schedule input via manual form or calendar upload
Matching engine based on course overlap, overlapping availability, and study style preferences
Real-time or near real-time chat functionality between matched users
Reporting and moderation tools for user safety

user_stories.i_want: to create an account using my university email
user_stories.so_that: I can access the study group platform securely and connect with verified peers
acceptance_criteria: System accepts only valid university domain email addresses
User receives a verification email to activate the account
User can set a password adhering to security standards

user_stories.i_want: to input my enrolled courses and weekly availability
user_stories.so_that: the system knows when and what I am studying
acceptance_criteria: User can search and select courses from a predefined list
User can select free time blocks on a weekly calendar grid
User can update or delete course and schedule details at any time

user_stories.i_want: to specify my preferred study style
user_stories.so_that: I am matched with peers who have compatible learning habits
acceptance_criteria: User can select study style tags such as quiet focus, active discussion, or flashcard review
Preferences are saved to the user profile

user_stories.i_want: to view a list of recommended study group matches
user_stories.so_that: I can choose who to connect with based on mutual availability and courses
acceptance_criteria: System generates matches based on overlapping courses, matching schedules, and study styles
User sees a compatibility percentage or breakdown for each match
User can send a connection request to a recommended peer

user_stories.i_want: to chat with my accepted study matches
user_stories.so_that: we can coordinate meeting times and locations
acceptance_criteria: Chat window unlocks only after a connection request is accepted by both parties
Users can send and receive text messages in real-time
Users can view message history within the chat interface
All core features must be fully functional within the 5-week timeframe
Application must be responsive and usable on both desktop and mobile web browsers
No paid external APIs or services may be utilized

risks.description: The matching algorithm might be too complex to implement accurately within the five-week limit.
Low initial user adoption on campus could result in empty match pools for testing.
